records.researcher_notes: An ETF Trends article from November 2025 quotes an Energy Transfer investor relations vice president. He says the Hugh Brinson pipeline runs near Abilene, Texas, where Oracle is building data centers, and that Oracle is a major customer. Energy Transfer's second quarter 2026 release also reports a 14-mile lateral off the pipeline in Abilene.
